ritual.heroDescription: Born from a small kitchen in 2021, Olive Organics began as a passion project — crafting homemade, organic personal care products with love and intention. Today, we bring that same handmade authenticity to every bar, bottle, and blend.
ritual.originText: What started as a simple desire for clean, chemical-free skincare grew into a mission. We source ethically, formulate by hand, and believe that what touches your skin should be as pure as what nourishes your body. Every product is crafted in small batches to ensure the highest quality and freshness.
ritual.philosophyText: We believe in the power of nature. No synthetic fragrances, no parabens, no compromises. Just pure botanical ingredients combined with traditional Ayurvedic wisdom and modern dermatological science.

products.name: Handcrafted Soaps
products.description: Cold-pressed, naturally scented soap bars made with organic oils and botanical extracts. Each bar is cured for 6 weeks for the perfect lather.

products.name: Herbal Shampoo
products.description: Sulfate-free, plant-based shampoo formulated with neem, amla, and hibiscus extracts for naturally strong and shiny hair.

products.name: Hair Oil Blends
products.description: Cold-pressed coconut, castor, and olive oil infused with brahmi, bhringraj, and rosemary for deep nourishment and growth.

products.name: Custom Formulations
products.description: Build your own products. Choose your base, select ingredients, pick a fragrance — we craft it fresh just for you.

timeline.title: The Kitchen Lab
timeline.description: Started making soaps at home for family and friends using traditional cold-process methods.

timeline.title: First Market
timeline.description: Launched at local organic markets. Sold out in the first weekend. Word spread fast.

timeline.title: Product Expansion
timeline.description: Introduced herbal shampoo and hair oil blends. Moved to a dedicated small-batch production studio.

timeline.title: Going Digital
timeline.description: Launched the online store with custom formulation capabilities. Customers can now build their own products.

timeline.title: Community of 5000+
timeline.description: Grew to a loyal community of customers across the country. Every product still handmade with care.

testimonials.name: Ayesha R.
testimonials.text: I switched from commercial soap to Olive Organics 6 months ago. My skin has never been this soft. The lavender bar is my absolute favourite.

testimonials.name: Priya K.
testimonials.text: The custom formulation is brilliant. I built a soap with neem and charcoal for my oily skin and it works better than any branded face wash I've tried.

testimonials.name: Rahul M.
testimonials.text: Bought the hair oil for my wife as a gift. She loved it so much she ordered 3 more. The quality is exceptional and you can tell it's made with real ingredients.

testimonials.name: Fatima S.
testimonials.text: Finally a brand that doesn't use parabens or synthetic fragrance. My eczema has improved dramatically since I started using their oatmeal soap.

testimonials.name: Deepa V.
testimonials.text: The herbal shampoo is a game changer. My hair fall reduced noticeably within the first month. No silicones, no sulfates, just pure herbs.

testimonials.name: Amira J.
testimonials.text: I love that I can customize everything. The sandalwood fragrance soap is luxurious — feels like a spa experience every morning.
